sqlMap.select: SELECT NVL(buyer_item_no,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , NVL(unit_price, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS LOAD_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS LOAD_TIME FROM ICOMPODT WHERE buyer = #BUYER# AND legacy_po_no = #LEGACY_PO_NO# AND legacy_po_seq= #LEGACY_PO_SEQ# AND status != 'D' AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT
TO_CHAR(NVL(COUNT(*), 0)) AS TOT_CNT, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(GR_AMT),0)) AS TOT_AMT, TO_CHAR(NVL(COUNT(DECODE(IF_FLAG,'E','X',NULL)), 0)) AS ERR_CNT, TO_CHAR(NVL(COUNT(DECODE(STATUS, 'D','D',NULL)), 0)) AS DEL_CNT FROM IF_GRDT WHERE BUYER = NVL(#BUYER#,' ') AND LEGACY_GR_NO = NVL(#LEGACY_GR_NO#,' ') AND REVISION = NVL(#REVISION#,' ')
sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO IF_GRDT A USING ( SELECT NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#) ,' ') AS BUYER, NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_GR_NO#) ,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_GR_SEQ#) ,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ,
